accepted_baseline: v0.9.0-rc.3 plus hardware-accepted Fire Emblem Engine B C/D VRAM address-mapping fix

fpga.sources: All recorded FPGA, RTL and third-party input hashes match this tree. Exact hardware-tested RBF retained; no FPGA rebuild for packaging.

host.behavior_change: Release version label only; all other frontend binary bytes except GNU build ID unchanged from the tested beta.

wc_module.source_note: Original 5.15 binary retained; common source has a version-gated Linux 6.3+ VMA flags API.

publication_status: Local release candidate; publication requires user approval.

validation.hardware: User confirmed Fire Emblem corruption fixed on MiSTer. No new instrumented FPS comparison reported. Both Linux module binaries and clock-control scripts remain identical to rc.3.
validation.host: 34 Python launcher/clock tests, 10 package audit controls and two focused menu suites pass. Release host differs from the accepted rc.3 host only in the version label and GNU build ID.
validation.packaging: Public source and archive audits, internal/outer checksums, modes and component identities required before readiness; no user BIOS, firmware, ROMs, saves or settings included.
validation.rtl: 40,960 C/D aperture checks plus CPU/enable/OFS, overlap and backreference cases; 262,144 existing H/I checks. Both suites pass. The C/D negative control fails at 0x06220000 on the pre-fix decoder.
